description: 전남광주통합특별시 광양시_버스 노선 정보 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 전남광주통합특별시 광양시. 본 서비스는 전라남도 광양시에서 운행 중인 버스 노선의 정류소 ID, 정류장 명칭, 위·경도 좌표, 정류장 순번 등의 상세 정류장 정보와, 휴일·평일 배차 간격, 전체 정류장 수,. Coverage: 전남광주통합특별시 광양시. The portal files it under the publisher 전남광주통합특별시 광양시. Its tags are 전라남도 광양시, 버스정보, BIS, 노선, 순번. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2026-01-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
